description: Development sample from the author-provided YG-Dataset directory; not the paper official full dataset or benchmark split.
selection: Preserve original split membership; keep filename-series proxies disjoint; exclude entire images with any invalid annotation/metadata issue; cover observable box-count, box-area, brightness and source-family diversity.
group_semantics: Filename series and source families are inferred proxies, not verified acquisition/tree/orchard identities. Unknown wider scene associations can remain.
